verdict.summary: The design-only change is internally coherent and is supported by the referenced implementation. It correctly rejects receipt-head reachability as unsound recovery/terminal evidence, distinguishes absent provenance from the already-repairable present-but-inadmissible class, keeps unavailable or platform-owned evidence fail-closed, and places the authoritative unmintability decision with the existing run-log parser rather than duplicating that trust parser in groom. The proposed sequence also appropriately requires a durable author-filtered receipt, measurement before action, exact code matching, retention of the machine park alongside the human hold, and negative-path tests before any escalation ships. The document clearly discloses the unavailable live measurements and does not change behavior, tests, workflows, policy, or trust checks in this PR.
